candidates.title: Extract invoice fields for review

demandEvidence.chore: Extract a few fields from operator-supplied invoice PDFs into a review sheet; exclude time reporting, customer follow-up and financial decisions.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera ekonomi och tidsrapportera– sköta fakturering, följa upp kunder och rapportera nyckeltal till ägaren

ease.reason: The attached templates describe extracting invoice fields and logging them; a learner can test with fictional PDFs, though setup details are not documented.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small professional offices may value less manual invoice entry; the notice is a human vacancy, not proof of AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can extract a few fields into a review sheet using the documented template pattern; varied invoice layouts and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: Extraction and logging can repeat, but a person must verify every field and handle customer follow-up, payment and reporting decisions.

evidence.reason: The notice names invoicing and time reporting; templates show invoice extraction and logging, but no frequency, local rules or AI buyers.

candidates.reason: Concrete invoice work supports a bounded test. The attached invoice templates support extraction and logging, but the equally weighted mean is 5.4, below the 6 threshold.

candidates.title: Index records for human filing

ease.reason: A fictional metadata list is possible, but attached templates cover invoice extraction rather than case registration or archiving.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional offices may value less records administration; the paid role does not establish demand for this AI service.

feasibility.reason: A mock index could be made from supplied fictional fields, but the notice gives no filing schema and references do not support the workflow.

autonomy.reason: A draft index can be repeated, while a person must classify, verify and file records; no source supports automated case handling.

evidence.reason: The notice explicitly names registration, case recording and archiving, but gives no frequency, fields or corroboration.

candidates.reason: The notice states registration, case recording and archiving, but available templates do not support this workflow; mean 4.0 is below threshold.
